query_fields.description: For query: ordered native receipt, sidecar/delta scan IDs and multiplicities, base/sidecar/delta candidate keys, answer IDs, oracle digest, CUDA timings and transfer timings.

certificate_fields.description: For direct attempt: current tree checksum, actual leaf, ordered physical-child path, strict radial checks, reason if rejected, and publication binding.

rebuild_fields.description: For rebuild: pre/post maps and active digests, materialized-set digest, old/new topology digests, publication status, first-post-rebuild query binding, rebuild wall time.
